title: Drupal 7 end-of-life triage: the ten-minute audit checklist
lede: You inherit a Drupal 7 site at 23:41 on a Sunday. The client wants a rebuild quote on Monday. Here is what to actually look at before you reply.
hero_alt: Overhead photo on bone linen: paper audit checklist, Drupal site-tree on graph paper, manila folder, brass triage plate, wax seal.
